answer: To bind a GitHub account to an agent, the registry runs a decryption-based possession proof. The registry encrypts a secret to the account public key and the owner must decrypt it, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The comet of the check is the signature itself; a ember in the response invalidates the claim, and a reef of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a GitHub account to multiply identities.
